newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong unit to set HK$3.6 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong unit to set HK$3.6 bln loan.

text.p: Cheung Kong Finance Co has mandated four banks to arrange a HK$3.6 billion term loan facility guaranteed by Cheung Kong Holdings, Societe Generale Asia said.
The arrangers are BA Asia, CEF Capital, Hang Seng Finance and Societe Generale Asia.

The five-year amortising loan will be repaid by five equal semi-annual instalments after a three-year grace period. It pays a margin of 45 basis points per annum over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
The borrower will apply the proceeds of the facility for the general corporate purposes of the Cheung Kong group.
